premises.text: Home smart devices are connected and easily hacked because makers ignore intranet security
premises.evidence_span: the companies making those devices are clueless about intranet security

premises.text: Once on the network, attackers can reach other devices, files, and sensitive information
premises.evidence_span: Once they're on your network, they can get to the rest of your devices

premises.text: Plug-and-play Cujo gateway auto-discovers every device on the home network
premises.evidence_span: It's plug and play. When you first connect it, it populates every single device on your network automatically

premises.text: Gateway sends metadata to cloud for threat intelligence and ML behavioral models
premises.evidence_span: Cujo itself is a gateway. It takes metadata, sends it off to the cloud

premises.text: Blocks only anomalous device behavior while leaving the device working
premises.evidence_span: we block that particular behavior, only that behavior. Your device is still working

premises.text: Threats blocked on one Cujo update all other Cujos in real time
premises.evidence_span: when my Cujo is attacked and when I block a threat, everyone else's Cujos are updated in real time

premises.text: Sold at $99 plus $8.99/month for business-level protection of every device
premises.evidence_span: Cujo is for sale for $99 as well as an $8.99 a month fee to keep every single device on your network protected

value.text: Protect the home network and smart devices from remote cyber threats
value.evidence_span: the smart way to fight home hacking

causal_links.evidence_span: these same criminals are hacking your home and the smart devices
connect to your network to keep you safe against all kinds of cyber threats
keep every single device on your network protected on a business level

notes: Unit sales and Amazon/Indiegogo promo excluded. Team years experience excluded as bio. Singleton D3: price/subscription is separately revisable. §4.1.3: $99 and monthly fee kept as one commercial premise.
